description: This file defines the `ReportGroup` class within the `OrangeHRM` human resource management system. It represents a report group entity with properties for ID, name, and core SQL, annotated for ORM (Doctrine) mapping to the database table `ohrm_report_group`. The class includes constants for predefined report group types and accessor methods.

classes.name: ReportGroup
classes.description: Entity class representing a report group with properties for ID, name, and SQL, mapped to a database table.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the report group.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the report group.

methods.name: getCoreSql
methods.description: Returns the core SQL associated with the report group.

methods.name: setCoreSql
methods.description: Sets the core SQL for the report group.
